facts.value: September 24, 2026 (9 AM) to October 16, 2026 (5 PM) (subject to available places)
The placement test is available in 3 languages (English, French & Spanish) to assess language proficiency.

The placement test evaluates subject-specific vocabulary, grammar, and understanding through single-choice, matching, and gap-fill tasks. It is an online test that can be taken from home and takes about 30 minutes.
The result of the placement test is a recommendation and does not mandate participation in the respective language level.
The course fee is 90 EUR (2 hours per week / 13 weeks).
It is advisable to use your student email address from Goethe University (@stud.uni-frankfurt.de) for registration.
You will receive an automatic confirmation email; if not received, contact the WIS team at wis@wiwi.uni-frankfurt.de.
Payment must be made within 3 working days after registration; otherwise, the place will be given to other students.
Please include the 16-digit invoice number with your payment to ensure proper processing.
There is a two-step registration process with different deadlines. You must participate in both stages and pass the online qualifying test.
Exam registration and deregistration period: October 8, 2026 – October 21, 2026 through QIS.
Remaining slots will be available on October 22, 2026; detailed information will be published on the website.
An enrollment is only valid if a language certificate is available or acquired.
Online qualifying tests will take place on September 28, 2026: English from 9 AM to 11 AM, French from 12 PM to 2 PM, Spanish from 3 PM to 5 PM.
Only specific certificates are recognized as valid language proof.
Cambridge English C1 certificate, TOEFL Test with a minimum score of 100 points, IELTS Test starting from 7.5 points.
Baccalauréat, Abibac, DALF / DELF C1.
Language certificate C1 from completing a Bachelor's selective module in Economic Spanish in previous semesters.
The qualifying test consists of multiple-choice questions assessing grammar, vocabulary (especially in economics), and text comprehension.
The required level to pass this test is B2.2.
